target_customer: Frontier AI labs that buy custom training data, RL environments and evaluations
problem: Frontier labs need specialized datasets, verifiable RL environments and evals across complex domains that general data vendors do not supply.
business_model: Custom data and environment contracts with AI labs plus off-the-shelf datasets
product_category: AI training data and RL environments

founders.name: Can Zehebi
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists no background.

founders.name: Ilkan Gezer
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists no background.

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: Builds high-fidelity RL environments and evals for frontier coding agents, sold to AI labs
competitors.traction_then: Not stated in the result seen
competitors.funding_then: About 9M angel round reported for April 2025 (single result)

technical_complexity.rationale: Producing verifiable datasets, rubric based RL and tool-calling or simulation environments is demanding in domain expertise and quality control, but not a research breakthrough.

defensibility.rationale: Many data vendors and RL environment startups offered similar services in 2025, and labs can switch vendors easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large data labeling companies were building RL environments by September 2025 per TechCrunch; no direct action against Zavo found.

market_need_then: Labs were reportedly spending heavily on RL environments by September 2025 (press reports of billion dollar spending discussions), creating demand for specialist vendors.

branding.domain_note: Uses zavo.ai; other companies use the Zavo name with zavo.io and zavopay.com

identity.logo: logo files exist in standard and white versions, design not described
identity.visual_style: simple layout with blog and contact form
identity.voice_and_tone: Research lab tone with the tagline Defining the new frontier

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press found. At least two other companies use the Zavo name (a procurement platform and a restaurant POS startup), and a London based ZAVO LTD filed a trademark in May 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared with other companies, producing confusion in data sources, and no brand assets or press were found.

outcome_analysis: Zavo is an active Fall 2025 company in London and San Francisco selling data and RL environments to frontier AI labs. No funding, customers or outcome were found in primary or credible sources, and no news after the batch exists. The market is crowded with larger data vendors, so little can be said beyond its early stage.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, StartupIntros) report a 500K seed in September 2025 from Y Combinator, but they describe a restaurant payments and AI POS company, which conflicts with the YC page description (data research lab), so the figure is unverified and possibly belongs to a different Zavo. Mechanize funding figure comes from a single secondary result. Founder education and employers not found. Name origin not found.
